concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: a revive item. A clear glass vial, cylindrical with a rounded shoulder, holding a single large golden feather suspended in soft glowing amber-honey liquid, closed with an ornate brass screw cap with a small ring on top, a thin brass band around the base so it stands upright. Warm gold and amber glow, white and pale-blue accents like the revive flower reference (second image). About 0.42 m tall. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN: stout clear glass vial, golden feather in amber liquid, ornate brass cap with ring and brass base band with cream inlay; all 3 views consistent
